name: Favicon InBrowser.App · Favicon Generator

title.zh: Favicon InBrowser.App · 上传图标比较桌面与PWA呈现

description.zh: 看同一公开输入的实际PWA预览和HTML集成输出。 Favicon InBrowser.App把图片用于网站图标，可预览桌面标签、搜索结果与PWA图标，并提供资源下载入口和HTML集成代码。页面自称在浏览器运行，本次用公开许可SVG实看预览，未验下载包、离线或隐私保证；源码可读，工具许可、费用与商用范围仍未知。
description.en: Favicon InBrowser.App previews an uploaded image as desktop, search and PWA icons and provides asset-download controls and HTML integration code. A publicly licensed SVG produced visible previews. Downloads, offline operation and privacy claims were not verified. Source is readable; the tool’s license, price and commercial permissions remain unknown.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Favicon InBrowser.App (https://favicon.inbrowser.app/).
Technology stack: vue.
Component specification: 看同一公开输入的实际PWA预览和HTML集成输出。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在官网工具页上传公开许可的Lucide终端SVG，搜索结果与明暗标签预览实际换成该图标。下滚能看到PWA圆形图标和HTML集成代码，适合比较网站图标在不同位置的呈现。下载入口可见，本次没有下载资源包或验证离线和隐私声明。源码公开可读，工具自身许可、费用与商用范围仍未知；测试图的ISC许可单独保留。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
